svg.title: Accelerator-system accelerator architecture
svg.desc: Queue 0 owns the O3 host, unified host cache, shared RAM, noncoherent global crossbar and host adapters. Each gem5 accelerator queue owns its scalar core, private L1I/L1D, coherent local crossbar, DMA and 256 KiB TCM.

g.text: One gem5 process · nine event queues / simulation threads
gem5 NonCoherentXBar interconnect · shared CPU / DMA contention · MSI target
Each link: timestamped PacketPtr ownership transfers · requests, responses, and credits
All nine queues synchronize every Q ticks; Q is bounded by the minimum delay on every crossing.
Each gem5 subsystem runs only on its owning queue; CPU, caches and DMA schedule local events.
